```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(GenomicAlignments)


cigarGrangesPairs <- function(bam_file) {
	bam <- BamFile(bam_file)
	aln <- readGAlignments(bam,use.names = TRUE)
	
	ref_rg <- cigarRangesAlongReferenceSpace(
			cigar(aln), pos = start(aln),
		  ops = c("M", "=", "X"), reduce.ranges = FALSE,f=as.factor(seqnames(aln))
		) |>
		GRanges(seqinfo = seqinfo(bam))
	
	
	qry_len <- cigarWidthAlongQuerySpace(cigar(aln), before.hard.clipping = TRUE)
	qry_rg <- cigarRangesAlongQuerySpace(
		  cigar(aln),
		  ops = c("M", "=", "X"), reduce.ranges = FALSE,
		  before.hard.clipping = TRUE
		) |>
		setNames(names(aln))
	aln_idx <- rep(seq_along(aln),lengths(qry_rg))
	
	qry_rg <- GRanges(
		qry_rg,
		strand = rep(strand(aln),lengths(qry_rg)),
		seqinfo = tibble(seqnames=names(aln),seqlengths=qry_len) |> distinct() |> as("Seqinfo")
	)
	ranges(qry_rg)[strand(qry_rg)=="-"] <- reflect(
		ranges(qry_rg)[strand(qry_rg)=="-"],
		IRanges(1,seqlengths(qry_rg)[as.integer(seqnames(qry_rg[strand(qry_rg)=="-"]))])
	)
	
	DataFrame(aln_idx,ref = ref_rg,query = qry_rg)
}



grangesPairsPolygons <- function(bedpe) {
	bind_rows(
		"r" = as_tibble(bedpe$ref) |> tibble::rowid_to_column("polygon_id") |> bind_cols(aln_idx = bedpe$aln_idx),
		"q" = as_tibble(bedpe$query) |> tibble::rowid_to_column("polygon_id") |> bind_cols(aln_idx = bedpe$aln_idx),
		.id = "source"
	) |>
		select(-width) |>
		dplyr::rename("1"="start","2"="end") |>
		pivot_longer(cols = c("1","2"),names_to = "order",names_transform = list(order=as.integer)) |>
		mutate(order = case_when(
			source=="r" ~ order,
			source=="q" & strand!="-" ~ 5 - order,
			source=="q" & strand=="-" ~ 2 + order,
			TRUE ~ NA_integer_
		)) |>
		select(-strand,-source) |>
		arrange(polygon_id,order)	
}
```

# Data loading

|          |                     |
|:---------|---------------------|
| BAM      | `r params$bam_file` | 
| Mutation | `r params$txt_file` |

```{r}
bedpe <- cigarGrangesPairs(params$bam_file)

muts <- read_tsv(
  params$txt_file,
  col_names = c("chrom", "pos", "change"),
  col_types = cols(pos="i",.default="c")
) |>
  mutate(
    ref = sub(">.*", "", change),
    alt = sub(".*>", "", change),
    type = case_when(
    	nchar(ref) == 1 & nchar(alt) == 1 ~ "SNP",
    	nchar(ref) < nchar(alt) ~ "INS",
    	nchar(ref) > nchar(alt) ~ "DEL",
    	TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )
```

# BAM alignment overview

```{r}
#| fig-height: 12
#| fig-width: 12
as_tibble(bedpe) |>
	select(-ref.width,-query.width) |>
	ggplot(aes(x=ref.start,xend=ref.end,y=if_else(query.strand=="-",query.end,query.start),yend=if_else(query.strand=="-",query.start,query.end))) + 
		facet_grid(query.seqnames~ref.seqnames,space="free",scales="free") +
		geom_segment() +
		theme_bw() + xlab("Reference") + ylab("Query")
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 12
ggplot() + 
	geom_polygon(aes(x=value,y=seqnames,group=polygon_id),fill="lightgrey",color="black",data=grangesPairsPolygons(bedpe)) +
	geom_segment(aes(x=1,xend=seqlengths,y=seqnames,yend=seqnames),linewidth = 2,data = as_tibble(seqinfo(bedpe$ref),rownames="seqnames")) +
	geom_segment(aes(x=1,xend=seqlengths,y=seqnames,yend=seqnames),linewidth = 2,data = as_tibble(seqinfo(bedpe$query),rownames="seqnames")) +
	geom_jitter(aes(y=chrom,x=pos+1L),data = muts,color="red",width=0,height=0.03) +
	theme_bw() + 
	xlab("Genomic position") + ylab("")
```

## Gaps

### Reference gaps

```{r}
local({
	ref_gaps <- gaps(bedpe$ref,ignore.strand=TRUE)
	tibble(
		pos = as.character(ref_gaps),
		width = width(ref_gaps)
	)
}) |>
	knitr::kable()
```

### Query gaps

```{r}
local({
	qry_gaps <- gaps(bedpe$query,ignore.strand=TRUE)
	tibble(
		pos = as.character(qry_gaps),
		width = width(qry_gaps)
	)
}) |>
	knitr::kable()
```

# Mutations

## Summary

```{r mut_summary}
muts |>
	group_by("Mutation type"=type) |>
	dplyr::count() |>
	knitr::kable()
```

## Mutations per contig

```{r mut_barplot, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
muts |>
  dplyr::count(chrom, type) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = chrom, y = n, fill = type)) +
    geom_col() +
    labs(x = "Contig", y = "Count", fill = "Type") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
```
